title: replay.camera_track_loaded
description: M10B: emitted when cf-replay-export::camera_director loads a *.camera.ron script and routes per-tick render commands to one of the 4 declared camera kinds (free_cam / follow_player / objective_cam / kill_cam) per VAL-M10B-024. Non-cosmetic.

start_tick.description: Inclusive start tick of this camera track's routing window.

end_tick.description: Exclusive end tick of this camera track's routing window.

keyframe_count.description: Number of keyframes declared on this track. The director interpolates per-tick pose via cubic Catmull-Rom between neighbouring keyframes.

script_path.description: Optional filesystem path to the *.camera.ron script the track was loaded from.
